definitions.gloss: abdication; stepping down from the throne
definitions.explanation: The voluntary relinquishment of a throne or supreme position of authority, especially by a monarch or emperor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{退位|たいい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{退位|たいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意向|いこう}→意向：12624_ikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He expressed his intention to abdicate.

examples.japanese: {退位|たいい}⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制定|せいてい}→制定：11907_seitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new era name was established accompanying the abdication.

notes:
Composed of {退|たい} (withdraw, retire) + ⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧ (rank, throne). Gained widespread use in Japan when Emperor Akihito expressed his wish to abdicate in 2016, leading to his abdication on April 30, 2019 — the first by a Japanese emperor in over 200 years. A special law was enacted to make this possible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退位|たいい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abdicate
- {退位|たいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意向|いこう}→意向：12624_ikou⟧: intention to abdicate
- {退位|たいい}{式|しき}: abdication ceremony
- ⟦{生前|せいぜん}→生前：16391_seizen⟧{退位|たいい}: abdication while still alive (as opposed to succession upon death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{即位|そくい}→即位：11974_sokui⟧: enthronement, accession to the throne (the opposite of {退位|たいい})
- ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧: resignation (from a political or professional position, not a throne)
- {譲位|じょうい}: ceding the throne (emphasizes transferring the position to a successor)
